notes.title: Ashen Knights: Foreshadow. Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Valiant Knights![/h2]

[h3]With great excitement, we announce that Ashen Knights: Foreshadow is finally available in Early Access! This moment has become possible thanks to the efforts of our development team, who have invested hundreds of hours of work and boundless passion into creating a new incredible world in the souls-like & hack’n’slash genre. We are proud to present to you the first three thrilling chapters of the story Campaign and four Unique Boss Battles!

But this is only the beginning of our journey! We promise to continue our work, gathering and analyzing your feedback and comments to make Ashen Knights: Foreshadow even better and more unique. Together, we will create not just a game, but a true adventure, full of excitement, thrilling battles, and emotions!

We thank you for your support and loyalty. Don't miss the opportunity to immerse yourself in this fantastic world and become part of the incredible story of Ashen Knights: Foreshadow![/h3]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008200/Ashen_Knights_Foreshadow/]Link - Ashen Knights: Foreshadow [/url][/h1]

notes.title: Ashen Knights Foreshadow. Early Access Release.
notes.notes:
We have come a long way with the efforts of our developers, and after many years, Ashen Knights Foreshadow has finally been released in early access. We will continue to put in a lot of work, gathering your feedback and comments to release an excellent game in version 1.0.

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008200/Ashen_Knights_Foreshadow/?beta=0]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008200/Ashen_Knights_Foreshadow/?beta=0[/url][/h3]

For the full version, we plan to include:
6 chapters of the story campaign
2 boss battles
1 mini-boss battle

Currently available in early access:
3 chapters of the story campaign
4 boss battles

[h3]
Join our Discord server for updates and more information!
[url=https://discord.gg/EeXB6RsSeY]https://discord.gg/EeXB6RsSeY[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Release time, here we go! One Passage is out and waiting for you, Ashen Knight!
notes.notes: What a long journey that was! What a fun journey that was! And finally, we’re at our destination point – the release. Merciless Primos and gracious Evelin, the Abyssal spawn and tricky bandits, regular mobs and mighty bosses – everything and everyone has finally arrived. Go through the first chapters of this grim story, fight and protect, solve and complete – do anything in this concentrated cocktail of Ashen Knights. Do it for free. Do it now. Play and enjoy, and come back for more in Foreshadow. Have a blast fighting, dear knights!
